deviations.what: T003 to T008 were committed as separate, task-labelled commits, but only the tree from the T008 commit on was run as a whole. The field change, the contributor change, the form wiring and the removal reference each other, so the earlier commits were not run on their own and may not be green individually.
deviations.why: Sample.location changes from a foreign key to a point, so every caller of the old row had to move together.

deviations.what: The two check constraints are listed in Sample.Meta and Measurement.Meta through location_constraints(), not declared on LocatedRecord.Meta as plan D1 says.
deviations.why: A sample type with no Meta of its own inherits the abstract parent's Meta, and makemigrations then created the constraints on child tables that hold none of the three columns.

deviations.what: Dataset.bbox now aggregates the samples' points with Extent instead of calling fairdm/contrib/location/utils.py.
deviations.why: The DataCite template and an existing test read dataset.bbox, and the helper read the removed Point rows. The spatial coverage story deletes it.

deviations.what: Migration contributors 0023 loads people with defer('location').
deviations.why: Its test runs historical models against the current schema, and 21 cases failed on the dropped column. The step uses nothing in that column.

deviations.what: Pre-existing tests changed beyond the brief's named list: test_config.py (location added to the rock form's field set), test_update.py (the portal-form tests add config instead of a person's location), test_seed_profiles.py (location_id read as location), test_menus.py and test_registration.py (two tests whose subject was the removed location page deleted).
deviations.why: Each one's subject or expected value is changed by a requirement of the story: RockSample lists location, a person has no location, and the Point plugin was the only record with no uuid.

deviations.what: lat-lon-parser was added in T001, not T006.

concerns: fairdm/contrib/plugins registry: declare_addressing, lookup_for and the pk-less reverse path now have no caller and no test, because the location page was the only record without a uuid (tests TestARecordWithoutAUuid and TestMenusExistForAnyRecord deleted). Forge to decide whether to keep or remove the machinery.

fairdm/contrib/contributors/forms/organization.py (OrganizationCreateForm and the older profile form) still list `location`, so they draw GeoDjango's default map widget for the new PointField. Plan D3 and US6 give them the point-only LocationField; left alone here as the brief prohibits organization form work.
makemigrations --check --dry-run reports one pending migration for the third-party orbit app in site-packages, as it did before this story. Project apps are clean.
The measurement overview template still reads own_location, which no view supplies until US3; only its sample branch was touched, to read the sample's own elevation and uncertainty fields.
tests/test_core/test_dataset/test_models.py::test_dataset_bbox_property accepts None or a dict, so it does not pin Dataset.bbox's shape; US7 deletes bbox.
docs/portal-development/locations.md covers the US1 surface only; later stories add the lookups, coverage, API and import columns, and CONTEXT.md gains Spatial coverage with them.
